title: When Is Shallow Enough? Adaptive Split Federated Learning with Client-Specific Sufficiency Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15639v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: \textit{Split Federated Learning} (SFL) enables distributed model training by splitting networks between the server and clients. However, under client heterogeneity, the conventional static split strategy may be suboptimal because clients can differ in data distributions, adaptation dynamics, and representation learning progress, making a single split point insufficient to accommodate client-specific training states. In this paper, we propose \textsc{FedSGA}, a \textbf{S}ufficiency-\textbf{G}uided \textbf{A}daptive split \textbf{Fed}erated learning framework that addresses this question through client-specific shallow sufficiency estimation. First, we introduce a client-specific adaptation channel based on private prompt tokens, which tracks local adaptation dynamics separately from the shared backbone and provides a lightweight signal for detecting whether client adaptation remains active. translated_title: 何时浅层足够？基于客户端充分性估计的自适应分割联邦学习
translated_abstract: 分割联邦学习（SFL）通过在服务器和客户端之间分割网络来实现分布式模型训练。然而，在客户端异构性下，传统的静态分割策略可能不是最优的，因为客户端在数据分布、适应动态和表示学习进展方面可能存在差异，这使得单一分割点不足以适应客户端特定的训练状态。在本文中，我们提出了FedSGA，一个基于充分性引导的自适应分割联邦学习框架，通过客户端特定的浅层充分性估计来解决这个问题。首先，我们引入了一个基于私有提示令牌的客户端特定适应通道，该通道在共享骨干网络之外独立跟踪本地适应动态，并提供轻量级信号来检测客户端适应是否仍然活跃。为了进一步避免重复的在线探测开销...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于客户端充分性估计的自适应分割联邦学习框架，通过私有提示令牌跟踪客户端适应动态，动态调整分割点以优化异构客户端下的训练效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive split federated learning framework with client-specific sufficiency estimation, using private prompt tokens to track adaptation dynamics and dynamically adjust split points for efficient training under client heterogeneity.
